title: Uniform approximation of spectra of linear second order differential operators via discrete sine transform based discretisation
summary: We study various discretisation schemes for the regular Sturm--Liouville operator on a bounded interval and for the Laplace operator on an arbitrary planar domain, in both cases subject to zero Dirichlet boundary conditions. The objective is to identify a discretisation scheme such that the corresponding discretised operator---a matrix of size $N \times N$---produces $N$ eigenvalues that approximate as closely as possible the first $N$ eigenvalues of the corresponding operator at the continuous level.
